Which term describes top-floor accommodation?

A balcony is an outside platform with a protective boundary. The view is the scenery visible from the room. An elevator carries guests between floors; Maya asks about it rather than assuming every room has a balcony.
Which item carries guests between floors?

A hallway connects the rooms. The ice machine supplies ice, while a vending machine sells packaged products. Omar wants ice rather than a snack and follows the hotel’s actual use instructions.
Which machine supplies ice?

Omar asks when the breakfast buffet opens. Maya checks the shuttle timetable and asks at the tour desk about a city visit. The receptionist explains wifi and parking information. They compare a single room with a double room for a future booking, then ask what the advertised price includes. They also discuss a suite and penthouse without assuming identical layouts across hotels. A balcony and view depend on the room description. An elevator reaches their hallway, which has an ice machine and vending machine. They confirm details rather than guessing from a room name.
